package_info.package_manager: custom/unknown (APT malware, not public package manager)
package_info.package_versions: N/A (custom APT tool, not versioned in public repositories)
package_info.why_malicious: USBCulprit is a custom backdoor tool used by the Cycldek (Goblin Panda) APT group to exfiltrate sensitive documents from air-gapped networks by copying them to a connected USB drive. Its sole purpose is unauthorized data collection and exfiltration, which is inherently malicious.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when USB drive is connected and tool is executed on target system)
execution_context.file_location: malware binary executed on compromised endpoint

malicious_snippets.code_language: python (pseudocode, actual malware likely C++ or similar)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code enumerates sensitive directories for document files, then copies matching files to a connected USB drive, enabling covert data exfiltration from air-gapped systems.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Automated collection and copying of sensitive documents to removable media is a classic data exfiltration technique, especially in air-gapped environments.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate software does not silently harvest and export user documents to external drives without user consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Backup utilities may copy user files to USB drives, but typically with user interaction and clear notification.
key_indicators: Targeted collection of document file types

attack_chain.action: Malware is introduced to the air-gapped system (e.g., via infected USB or lateral movement).
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of USBCulprit on the target system

attack_chain.action: USBCulprit scans for sensitive documents in predefined directories.
USBCulprit copies collected documents to a connected USB drive.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltration of sensitive data from air-gapped network

behavioral_signatures: Automated enumeration of user or system document directories
Bulk copying of files with sensitive extensions to removable media
Execution of unknown binaries with removable media access
file_indicators: Unexpected creation of document files on USB drives
Presence of unknown executables on endpoints with removable media access
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for processes that enumerate and copy large numbers of sensitive files to removable drives, especially in air-gapped or high-security environments. Alert on unknown binaries accessing removable media or performing bulk file operations without user interaction. Correlate with the presence of suspicious executables or tools not part of standard software inventory.
